```{python}
#| tags: [parameters]
project = "quarto"
```

```{python}
import duckdb
import polars as pl
from plotnine import *

con = duckdb.connect("../../data/velocirepo.duckdb")
df = con.sql(f"""
    SELECT date, date as age, value, SUM(value) OVER (ORDER BY age) AS stars
    FROM metrics
    WHERE metric = 'daily_stars' AND project = '{project}'
""").pl()

df = df.with_columns(
    pl.col("age") - pl.col("age").min(),
    pl.col("stars").cast(pl.Int64)
)
df
```

```{python}
(
    ggplot(df, aes(x="date", y="stars", group=1))
    + geom_line()
    + ggtitle(f"{project}")
)
```
